title: docs(skills): the automation skill no longer says a flow name two packages hold is never armed
body:
Part of #31696

This is the skills part of the card, and it removes one remark. The card stays open: `flow` joining `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`, the other `/automation` doors, the dogfood pins and the epic's Q4 pin belong to the card's final part, dispatched separately (seat rulings 6794435934 and 6794825287; step-0 ruling 6760193376 is unchanged). The inbound-hook line of this skill follows as its own skills PR after the switch.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-automation` 技能 `subflow` 行末尾的括注，删掉「; an older clash, never armed」这半句，现在读作 `(package / package-less caller)`。全 PR 只动这一处技能文本，外加一个 changeset。
- 为什么改：原句说「两个包持有同一个流程名时，两个都不会被武装」。自 #32239 起引擎按（包，名）各自持有并武装，自 #32374 起四种触发器按槽位各自触发，所以这句话在 `main` 上已经是错的，客户的 agent 照着读会以为这两个流程都不运行。
- 风险与回滚：只删半句技能文本，无运行时代码。行数不变（467 → 467），token 少 7（6861 → 6854，天花板 6861 未动）。括注不再对「是否武装」下任何断言，所以在每一种状态下都成立，命名空间开关落地前后也都成立。回滚即撤回此 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 第 76 行（`subflow` 行）行尾括注，diff 里唯一的技能改动。
- 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main...HEAD --word-diff -- skills`，预期只见 `[-caller; an older clash, never armed)-]{+caller)+}` 一处；再跑 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期该文件一行为 `6854 tokens (ceiling 6861; headroom 7)`。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触 `skills/**`（Tier H），需要一位授权审批人 Approve；之后由席位落地。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the `subflow` row. The refusal the row teaches is unchanged: a caller that names neither package is refused, naming both holders (`ambiguous-in-closure` for a package caller, `ambiguous-in-environment` for a package-less one). Only the remark about the two flows themselves goes: `(package / package-less caller; an older clash, never armed)` becomes `(package / package-less caller)`.
- `.changeset/31696-automation-skill-subflow-armed.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, with both declaration lines. It says the remark is removed and that nothing is said in its place.

Nothing else in the pack changes. No eval, example or reference file pins the old words: under `skills/` and `content/docs/`, `older clash` appears on this one line only, and the other `never armed` hits (under `content/docs/`) are about a flow with no `start` node, a different state.

## Tests

No package test is owed and no ablation was run: the diff deletes half a sentence of skill text and adds a changeset, and no tested behaviour changes. The removed remark was read against the landed code:

- `AutomationEngine.activateFlowTrigger` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:4020`) arms each slot of a name two packages hold under the slot's key, so "never armed" is false. Pin: `flow-triggers-per-slot.test.ts`, "each slot of a shared name fires its own body, and its run reads the flow's name in params".
- The same function returns before arming the one slot left when the other holder's body was refused (`engine.ts:4051`; pin `flow-slots-per-package.test.ts:328`), so "each armed" would not be true in every state either. That is why the remark is removed and not replaced.

Both pins were read, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope ruling.** The first round of this dispatch stopped with no PR (report 6794360256): the order had this PR complete the card, while the card's own build item (the flow switch) is not on `main`. The seat split the work (6794435934). The inbound-hook line that the first commit on this branch added (775b07f19c) was removed again by bacf69bb89, because the file sits at its token ceiling and that line costs 57 tokens.
- **Contract review 6794906104 (PASS at bacf69bb89, two findings to repair and one nit).** That head replaced the remark with "each armed". The review found the claim unconditional where the code declines to arm in one state (finding 1), found the antecedent of "each" lost (finding 2), and found the changeset repeating the claim (finding 3). The seat took the review's first repair: 4da63d45ff drops the remark and rewrites the changeset, which answers all three. The review of record is for the earlier head; this head needs its own.
- **Wording holds in every state.** The parenthetical now only maps the two refusal codes to the two kinds of caller. It makes no statement about arming or about how two packages came to hold the name, so the switch needs no second edit of this line.
- **The ceiling row is not touched.** `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` keeps the automation row at 6861; the file now measures 6854 (headroom 7). Lowering the row to the measurement is legitimate, but that script is outside this PR's file surface, so it is left to the seat.
- **History.** The branch carries four commits (the first text, a merge of `main` at 48d6b477c7, and two reductions), none force-pushed. The squashed diff is the two files above.
- **Serial constraint.** One page of open pulls (29) was read before the first edit; the three whose titles name skills, flows or hooks (#32384, #32391, #32214) do not touch `skills/objectstack-automation/**`.
